title: Nuclear REFUEL (Recycling Efficient Fuels Utilizing Expedited Licensing) Act

items.snippet: This bill directs the Nuclear Regulatory Commission (NRC) to license future recycling facilities that reprocess certain spent nuclear fuel (i.e., radioactive waste)…
